title: Applicability of NMR spectroscopy to quantify microplastics across varying concentrations in polymer mixtures
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13041-13052
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01174D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Julia Schmidt, Marte Haave, Wei Wang
qNMR spectroscopy is evaluated for quantifying synthetic polymers in mixtures. Overlapping signals and low concentrations challenge its application in environmental samples, but intermediate levels show promising results.
